Trial Log

Source: R/optimizer-logging.R
TrialLog.Rd

R6 class for managing a collection of trials with optional persistence. Provides methods for adding trials, querying results, and saving to disk.

Public fields

optimizer_name

Name of the optimizer using this log.

log_dir

Directory for persistence (NULL for in-memory only).

trials

List of Trial objects.

metadata

Additional metadata about the optimization run.
